svg.aria-label: Sketch after a photograph on NBC News: cargo ships anchored in the Strait of Hormuz off Bandar Abbas, Iran, in hazy overcast light. A dark-hulled freighter sits broadside at centre with two A-frame cranes and raised booms and a white superstructure at the stern; a smaller ship with two cranes rides at anchor at left, three more ships stand faint on the horizon, and at lower right a small tug tows a long flat barge off the edge of the frame. A single bird crosses the empty sky above. No people are in the scene.
